children: Indonesia's central bank Governor Destry Damayanti said she held a meeting on Thursday with the finance minister and discussed issues including liquidity, the government's bond issuance strategy and Bank Indonesia's rupiah-denominated securities.
Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara said the government's placement of cash reserves at state banks was also discussed.
